paired_box_comparison.scope: Common seeds can correlate boxes. The original9.2447 combined-SE z is descriptive only; this bound does not assume independent box estimates. It still resolves a finite-concentration/box difference, not DFT size convergence.

temperature_fit_scope: Descriptive250-400K fit, not a300K local LiEa proof. Same numeric seeds acrossT may correlate estimates; diagonal SE is not claimed as an independent-temperature uncertainty. The absolute-coefficient SE bound is given conservatively; non-Arrhenius curvature remains possible.
